image_description: A close-up shot of an ornate, multi-component necklace displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features a thick, metallic chain with large, irregular oval links that appear to be gold or bronze-toned. Hanging from the chain are several decorative elements: two large spherical beads with marbled patterns (one dark purple/black, one iridescent green/pink), a central spiral shell-like charm, and a dangling teardrop-shaped pendant with a metallic sheen. The background is a plain, out-of-focus white surface.
